description: Figure 7 illustrates how KV cache usage evolves over time in a streaming setting using two small line plots stacked vertically, labeled “Size\_{mem}” (top) and “Size\_{mem}′” (bottom), each showing a repeating ramp-and-drop (sawtooth) pattern as the stream progresses. In both plots, the x-axis is labeled with \(m_0\) at an intermediate position and \(m\) at the far right, with no numeric tick marks shown and an arrow indicating increasing \(m\); the y-axis has an upward arrow and a baseline at 0. In the top plot (“Size\_{mem}”), the y-axis includes two annotated horizontal reference levels labeled \(c-a\) (lower) and \(c-a/2\) (higher), and the line is a thin solid black line that rises linearly from near 0 up to the upper reference level, then drops sharply down near the lower reference level and repeats several smaller sawtooth cycles toward the right, with a dashed horizontal segment drawn at the \(c-a\) level and a dashed vertical segment near the first large peak. In the bottom plot (“Size\_{mem}′”), the y-axis includes a labeled reference level \(w+a+\beta\), and the solid black line similarly ramps upward from near 0 to approximately that level, then drops sharply and continues with repeated smaller sawtooth ramps and drops toward the right; a dashed horizontal segment is drawn around the \(w+a+\beta\) level and a dashed vertical segment appears near the first large peak, mirroring the styling of the top plot.
